ValidationRule.description: SEs and SysAdmins are the only ones that can close Sales Engineering type cases if the type is "System Workflow"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $RecordType.Id = "01200000000DKKj" && ISPICKVAL( Status, "Completed - Resolved") && ISPICKVAL(Contract_Help_Request_Type__c, "Systems Workflow") && NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") && NOT($Profile.Name = "Sales Engineering Lightning Pilot") && NOT($UserRole.Name = "Manager, Sales Engineering - US") && NOT($UserRole.Name = "Director, Global Sales Engineering & Renewals")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Sales Engineers can close System Workflow cases
